senses.gloss:
ऋतेन ind. Duly, rightly, truly,
honestly, justly.

ऋते ind. Except, without, with
the exception of (usually with
abl.); ऋते क्रौर्यात्समायातः
Bk. 8. 105; अवेहि मां प्रीतमृते तुरंगमात्
R. 3. 63; पापादृते Ś. 6. 22; Ku. 1. 51;
2. 57; sometimes with acc. ऋतेऽपि
त्वां न भविष्यंति सर्वे Bg. 11. 32; rarely
with instr.
